calculation_handling.description: A device producing renewable energy or cogeneration energy may not be in a front yard or a side yard that abuts a street.
calculation_handling.gaps: Needs the proposed location of the device.

calculation_handling.description: A cogeneration energy device must be inside a permitted building.
calculation_handling.gaps: No modelled requirement fits an equipment-in-building obligation.

units.disclosure: A cogeneration energy device must be inside a permitted building. The tool does not evaluate this.

calculation_handling.description: Any above-ground part of a geo-energy device must comply with the requirements for a building or structure on the lot.
calculation_handling.gaps: Compliance with another set of requirements is not evaluated for devices.

units.disclosure: The above-ground part of a geo-energy device must meet the requirements that apply to a building or structure on the lot. The tool does not evaluate this.

calculation_handling.description: Any above-ground part of a geo-energy device must comply with the requirements for an ancillary building or structure, if it is on a lot with a residential building.
calculation_handling.gaps: Compliance with another set of requirements is not evaluated for devices.

units.disclosure: The above-ground part of a geo-energy device on a lot with a residential building must meet the requirements for an ancillary building or structure. The tool does not evaluate this.

numeric_expression: height_projection_m = by_type(apartment_building: 2.0 m; non_residential_building: 2.0 m; other: 1.2 m) @(4)(A)

calculation_handling.description: A rooftop solar device may be no higher than 1.2 metres above the permitted maximum height for a residential building other than an apartment building, or 2.0 metres above it for an apartment building or non-residential building.
calculation_handling.gaps: The setback requirement in (4)(A)(i) is not part of the height value.

calculation_handling.description: A ground-mounted solar energy device must comply with the requirements for a building or structure on the lot and, on a lot with a residential building, for an ancillary building or structure.
calculation_handling.gaps: Compliance with another set of requirements is not evaluated for devices.

units.disclosure: A ground-mounted solar device must meet the requirements for a building or structure, and for an ancillary building or structure on a lot with a residential building. The tool does not evaluate this.

calculation_handling.description: There may be no more than one wind energy device on a lot.
calculation_handling.gaps: No modelled target counts energy devices.

units.disclosure: A lot may have no more than one wind energy device. The tool does not evaluate this count.

calculation_handling.description: All parts of a wind energy device must comply with the required minimum building setbacks for a building on the lot.
calculation_handling.gaps: The device location is not modelled.

units.disclosure: Every part of a wind energy device must respect the minimum building setbacks for the lot. The tool does not evaluate this.

calculation_handling.description: On a lot with a residential building other than an apartment building, no part of a wind energy device may be higher than 2.5 metres above the permitted maximum height for the building.

On a lot with an apartment building or non-residential building, a wind energy device may be no higher than 3.0 metres above the permitted maximum height if that height is under 24.0 metres or the lot abuts another Residential Zone category lot, and otherwise no higher than 5.0 metres above it.
calculation_handling.gaps: The test for abutting another Residential Zone category lot cannot be tied to a modelled lot condition, so the 3.0 / 5.0 metre choice is not computed.

units.disclosure: On a lot with an apartment or non-residential building, a wind device may be 3.0 metres above the permitted height if that height is under 24.0 metres or the lot abuts another Residential Zone category lot, and 5.0 metres above it otherwise. The tool does not compute this.

10.5.75.1(1).explanation: A renewable-energy or cogeneration device may not be placed in a front yard or in a side yard that abuts a street.

10.5.75.1(2).explanation: A cogeneration energy device must be inside a permitted building.

10.5.75.1(3).explanation: Above-ground parts of a geo-energy device must meet the requirements for a building or structure, and for an ancillary building or structure if the lot has a residential building, in addition to the front and street-side yard ban in 10.5.75.1(1).

10.5.75.1(4).explanation: A solar device on a building must meet the building setbacks and stay within 1.2 m (houses and other residential buildings) or 2.0 m (apartment and non-residential buildings) of the permitted maximum height. A ground-mounted solar device follows the rules for a building or structure and, on a residential lot, for an ancillary building.

10.5.75.1(5).explanation: A lot may have only one wind energy device, which must respect building setbacks. It may rise no more than 2.5 m above the permitted height on a lot with a residential building other than an apartment building, and 3.0 m or 5.0 m above it on a lot with an apartment or non-residential building, depending on height and neighbours.
